notes.title: Castle Cab looks like Crazy Taxi but with an unhinged horse and silly customization
notes.content:
Crazy Taxi delivery sim but with a horse and carriage, plus some over the top physics? Castle Cab really does look like a lot of fun.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/06/castle-cab-looks-like-crazy-taxi-but-with-an-unhinged-horse-and-silly-customization/
